Gap: tracing is turned off only once, at the stream generator's first step (graph.py:746-757), so a caller that enters tracing_v2_enabled() or langsmith.tracing_context(enabled=True) between stream steps re-enables LangSmith tracing for the later steps of a run under the lock (finding 1).

draft_prompt (src/cma/graph.py) writes the placeholder account name, the period, met.as_table (src/cma/metrics.py:295-299: id, name, value, fixed method sentences at metrics.py:128-290) and rules_table(for_prompt=True), which masks any rule that is not the shipped rule whole (_is_shipped, including on_fail/when_missing and bands) and re-spells shipped limits; the policy name and the overall-outcome line are gone, and the outcome is a table row. The redraft line carries only metric ids and shipped rule ids (redraft_ids); the guard's findings never reach a prompt. test_p5_* tests passed in invariants-5.log.

test_p5_no_prompt_carries_line_level_text (every archetype, profile and hallucinate setting), the custom-id, description, limits, bands, actions, spelling and CLI --policy tests passed (invariants-5.log). The prompt holds only tool text and case-decided values per revisions 32 and 33; nothing description- or profile-derived was found in as_table methods or in the rule details for shipped rules.

P18 tests passed (invariants-5.log), including the with_config copy test and the tracing_v2 context tests. P18 validates R29's revision 32 scope that a run under the lock is untraced; a locked stream whose caller re-enters a tracing context between steps is traced (finding 1), so the property does not hold for every run under the lock.

findings.claim: Under the offline lock, the stream and astream wrappers clear tracing_v2_callback_var and enter langsmith.tracing_context(enabled=False) once, in the generator's first step (start() at graph.py:748, 720; graph.py:751). A sync or async generator runs in its caller's context, and LangGraph copies the caller's current context for each step (langgraph/pregel/_executor.py:72-79). A caller that enters tracing_v2_enabled() between two next() calls therefore sets tracing_v2_callback_var again for the later steps. _tracing_v2_is_enabled() then returns True (langchain_core/tracers/context.py:141-144), and _configure adds that tracer to each node's callback manager, since the filter left no LangChainTracer there (langchain_core/callbacks/manager.py:2483-2515). The later node runs, with the state and statement data as inputs, are exported to LangSmith. A caller's langsmith.tracing_context(enabled=True) entered mid-stream has the same effect. This fails R29's 'a run under the lock is untraced: LangSmith's own tracing is off whatever the environment says' and P18. Verdict PLAUSIBLE: found from the sources, not run, because the shell was denied.
